Network Outage Detection, Triage and Communication

Document ID: SOP_C08_OUTAGE_MANAGEMENT

Category: C08 — Network Coverage & Outages

Department: Network

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Purpose

To define how network outages are detected, classified by severity, and communicated to affected customers.

Severity Classification

Procedure

NOC detects fault via automated alarms or customer-reported tickets crossing threshold.

Assign severity per the table above and open an incident record.

Dispatch field team / activate failover (e.g., COW, backup backhaul) as applicable.

Publish status to the customer-facing Service Status page within 30 minutes of P1/P2 classification.

Close the incident once service is confirmed restored for 30 continuous minutes; trigger RCA process for all P1 incidents.

Related Documents

KB_C08_outage_status_check, TRN_002, RCA process (see RCA_TEMPLATE)
